output:
I'll start by reading the docs and inspecting the code.

The middle of the spec was cut off. I'll read it in full.

The last call was cut off before it ran. I'll make the edits one file at a time, starting with `text.py`.

The `shell` call was cut off again before it ran, so I'll use `edit_file` for the remaining changes.

The `export` command is finished and follows the spec as far as I checked it. The unit tests pass (28 tests, `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). I also ran several option combinations by hand and compared the output with the spec. Those runs covered the `en-IN` locale, `--sort` with null placement, `--null`, `--delimiter tab`, and `--max-rows` with a dotfile name. I didn't write a full byte-for-byte check of every rule.

I made these changes, all under `/app/tally`:
- **`--where`:** it was never evaluated, so I wrote that part. Null values make comparisons false, and `not` is plain negation. I also limited number tokens to ASCII digits.
- **Locale dates and numbers:** I wrote the date and time patterns, including the 12-hour clock and AM/PM. Digit grouping now uses the locale's `group_sizes` and `min_grouping`. Canonical dates no longer use `strftime`, which doesn't zero-pad years below 1000.
- **CSV text:** the code used Python's `csv` module, which got several rules wrong, so I replaced it. Records now end with CR LF. A field is quoted only under the spec's conditions (including leading or trailing space or tab, or equal to the null token). The null token is never quoted.
- **`--sort`:** an explicit `nulls-first` or `nulls-last` was being flipped by `:desc`. It now holds whatever the direction.
- **`--max-rows` file names:** the number is now inserted before the suffix, which starts at the last `.` (not the first). All numbers share one width, at least three digits.

I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app; cat docs/overview.md docs/conventions.md docs/export.md; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

cd /app; for f in tally/export/*.py tally/commands/export.py tally/commands/__init__.py tally/commands/query.py tally/commands/report.py tally/textio.py tally/errors.py tally/cli.py tally/fmt/locales.py tally/fmt/numbers.py tally/fmt/dates.py tally/store/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; git status 2>&1 | head
cd /app; sed -n 150,400p tally/export/expr.py; for f in tally/export/order.py tally/export/text.py tally/commands/export.py tally/commands/__init__.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

cd /app; for f in tally/fmt/numbers.py tally/fmt/dates.py tally/fmt/locales.py tally/textio.py tally/cli.py tally/errors.py tally/store/schema.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; cat tests/test_export.py tests/support.py; head -c 600 locales/*.json | head -150

cd /app; grep -h '"date"\|"datetime"\|group\|min_g\|minus' -A0 locales/*.json | sort | uniq -c; python - <<'E'
import json,glob
for f in glob.glob('locales/*.json'):
    d=json.load(open(f)); print(d['name'],d['group_sizes'],d['min_grouping'],[hex(ord(c)) for c in d['group']],[hex(ord(c)) for c in d['minus']])
E
cat tests/fixtures/store/*/schema.json | head -40

cd /app && python - <<'E'
import re
p='tally/export/csvtext.py'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('def record(')
s=s[:i]+'''def _field(text: str, delimiter: str, null: str) -> str:
    needs = (
        delimiter in text
        or any(c in text for c in ('"', "\\r", "\\n"))
        or text[:1] in (" ", "\\t")
        or text[-1:] in (" ", "\\t")
        or text == null
    )
    if needs:
        return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text


def record(fields: list, delimiter: str, null: str) -> str:
    """fields: texts, or None for a null value. Ends with CR LF (section 8)."""
    return delimiter.join(null if f is None else _field(f, delimiter, null) for f in fields) + "\\r\\n"
'''
s=s.replace('import csv\nimport io\n\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cat tally/export/csvtext.py | tail -25

cd /app && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -8; python -m tally export orders --locale en-IN --columns id,total,placed,due,paid --sort status:desc:nulls-last | head -20; python -m tally export orders --columns id,status --null NULL --where "status is null or status ~ 'o'"; python -m tally export people --out /tmp/x/.p --max-rows 1; ls -A /tmp/x

cd /app && python -m tally export orders --locale en-IN --columns id,total,placed,paid --sort status:desc,id:desc:nulls-first --where "id < 500010" | cat -A | head; python -m tally --store tests/fixtures/store export people --out /tmp/x/.p --max-rows 1 --null x --columns name,note; ls -A /tmp/x; cat -A /tmp/x/.p-001; python -m tally --store tests/fixtures/store export people --null Ada --columns name,note --delimiter tab | cat -A
cd /app && cat store/orders/schema.json | head -20; python -m tally export orders --locale en-IN --sort total:desc,id --where "id < 500010 or total >= 99999" | head -8 | cat -A
